text: Harbour City's patient short-passing approach in their 4-2-3-1 setup effectively dismantled Seabrook Town's wide defensive structure, culminating in a clear-cut chance created by Joon Whitfield's through ball to Marek Barros. The quick, controlled buildup with only two passes over 7.4 seconds highlights good positional play and midfield creativity. However, Barros's close-range shot was blocked, indicating a need to improve finishing under pressure even after well-constructed attacks. Focus training on composure and shot placement in tight situations to convert high-xG opportunities into goals. [#669] [#670] [#672]
